newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Avgold's Harties losing 6-8 kg gold a day.
newsitem.headline: Avgold's Harties losing 6-8 kg gold a day.

text.p: Avgold Ltd said on Tuesday that its Hartebeestfontein gold mine division was losing six to eight kg of gold output a day due to an underground rockburst last week which killed 18 mineworkers.

"The parts of the No 4 A shaft directly affected remain closed and we're losing six to eight kg a day there. We don't see any recovery from that position in the next couple of weeks," said Tim Spindler, manager of Avgold's mining operations.
A large seismic event last week at the mine's No 4 A shaft area at a depth below surface of about 2,170 metres resulted in severe damage to underground excavations.
Rescue teams worked for five days to recover the bodies of trapped miners and during that time the whole of the No 4 A shaft was out of commission costing the mine 15-18 kg of gold output a day.
Hartebeestfontein produced 5,143 kg of gold in the second quarter.
